card.name: Punctuation in journal citations
card.fires_on: Punctuation and spacing right after a journal name or volume in academic reference lists, such as the "(" before an issue number or the ":" after a year or issue. Also fires weakly on scattered other words in scholarly or news text.

modes.label: Volume and issue punctuation
modes.description: Open bracket, close bracket, colon or space between journal name, volume, issue and pages in a citation.

modes.label: Scattered scholarly words
modes.description: Names or words in academic or news prose, such as a researcher's surname or an institution.
modes.example: said researcher Patrick Petitje<<an>>, a quasar expert at the Institute

card.plain: It marks the punctuation inside journal references, between the journal title, volume, issue and page numbers.
